verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim exposes a documented Python API (namespace packages installable via pip) and ROS 2 services/actions for loading worlds, spawning entities, and stepping simulations, giving programmatic/agentic control over simulation. However, probes show no OpenAPI/REST spec or llms.txt, and there's no independent evidence of AI agents actually driving it via this API. Missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI-style public API surface, AI-focused API discovery file (llms.txt), and independent/hands-on corroboration of programmatic control by an AI agent.
